business.name: jenpharm
business.description:
Jenpharm is a Pakistan-based skincare, haircare and wellness brand that has been operating for around 14 years. The company positions itself around science-backed formulations, clinically researched ingredients and products developed alongside dermatologists and other experts.

Its product portfolio includes:

Skincare: cleansers, moisturizers, serums, face washes, treatment creams and masks
Sun protection: multiple sunscreen/sunblock products
Haircare: shampoos, hair serums and anti-dandruff products
Targeted concerns: acne, hyperpigmentation, oily skin, dryness, hair fall, dandruff and skin aging
Bundles: skincare and haircare combinations
business.additional_info:

However, third-party e-commerce intelligence platform Particl estimates that Jenpharm generated approximately 913 million in e-commerce sales over its most recent six-month tracking period, with approximately 779,000 units sold. It also reports approximately 103 million in sales during April 2025. These are third-party estimates, not company-reported financial statements, so for OpenCredit AI they should be classified as an estimated/third-party signal, not a verified financial fact
